operators.name: add_parameter
semantics: Performs elementwise addition: output = x + parameter, following PyTorch broadcasting rules.
parameter is broadcast from [16,3,1,1] to x's shape [16,3,4096,4096].
Result dtype is torch.float32, device is CUDA.
No in-place modification; returns a new tensor.
Elementwise addition with broadcasting: x shape [16,3,4096,4096], parameter shape [16,3,1,1].
Broadcasting aligns dimensions from the right; parameter is expanded to full input shape.
Result is a new tensor with same shape as x.
